features.feature: Create one explicit typed agent registry shared by dispatch consumers

Declare canonical name, aliases, role class, allowed phases, target cardinality and identifier kinds, prompt builder, mutation authority, commit guidance, reviewer lane, and evidence ownership for every type
Model implementer, verification-intent, INIT/product/scope/story/item/coverage/delivery reviewers, finding repair, cluster repair, and repository prompt assets without prefix-derived privilege
Preserve test-intent and test-case-reviewer only as deliberate compatibility aliases
Fail closed on unknown, blank-explicit, case-mutated, and prefix-lookalike agent types before prompt generation
Validate lifecycle phase and story/item/finding/cluster identifier kind and cardinality from the same registry contract
Ensure verification-intent and reviewer prompts never contain implementer commit-author, implementation, or checklist status:done guidance
Make every user-visible dispatch hint/example schema-valid and executable with the identifiers it displays
Mechanically prevent reviewers from writing implementer status and implementers from minting reviewer pass/finding evidence
Provide exhaustive table-driven positive and negative coverage for every type, alias, phase, cardinality, prompt class, and allowed or denied mutation class
Synchronize gate-consumed reviewer and evidence semantics with process-fact registry and contract verification
Reproduce RED-B19CA-DISPATCH and prove it green before completion
Rollback retains deliberate aliases and must not restore prefix-based privilege inference
Update the canonical role-separation subsystem owner document, or record a new canonical typed-dispatch decision, so shipped C4 semantics are not governed only by the umbrella plan
Do not absorb unattended host liveness or candidate-ranking specificity into B-19ca
